proposition: restart_between_reentry_and_done_recovers_nonterminal_state demonstrates crash/restart recovery.
refutation: The boundary is a context-manager close/reopen inside one process. No termination, signal or fsync path. It shows DB-derived recovery state only. F-V01-13 crash oracle stays open.

proposition: Repo-root CLAUDE.md states the current owner-fixed Frank v0.1 target.
refutation: CLAUDE.md declares 'Frank v0.1 voll lauffaehig auf Andreas PC' four times, while FRANK_V0_1_SERVER_BINARY_IDENTITY_AND_API_DIRECTIVE.md:18 explicitly supersedes 'Andreas PC = final target' and FRANK_V0_1_ONLY_PROGRAM_DIRECTIVE.md:13 fixes TARGET_BODY = accepted Hostinger Ubuntu VPS. Every organ boots into a superseded anchor at T0.

proposition: Model confidence, GWT ignition, ClayGraph salience and translator hints cannot mint effect authority.
refutation: Independently verified: evaluate() never reads the four cognitive fields; 1000/1000 randomized single-field mutations over 22 policy fields change request_hash, while mutating all four cognitive fields leaves it identical.

proposition: The V17 provenance-bound re-entry invariant depends on application-level checks.
refutation: Adversarial test: the Python attempt-identity guard was replaced with 'if False:'. The malformed re-entry was still refused by the schema (sqlite3.IntegrityError V17_REENTRY_CANONICAL_BINDING_MISMATCH). Six RAISE(ABORT) triggers carry the invariant.

proposition: ClayCode cannot be executed; only parsed to TypedIR.
refutation: A tree-walking evaluator over the existing FRANK_STRUCTURED_V1 grammar executes decide_effect from claycode/frank_effects.clay on the accepted target VPS. 200,576 requests compared against the Python reference, 0 mismatches.

proposition: The 29 unresolved call targets are a single class of work, closable by host contracts.
refutation: Three of the 29 (EffectReceipt, VerifiedEffectReceipt, DoneReceipt) are types used and constructed but declared in no .clay source. No host binding can resolve them; they require a ClayCode declaration. The remaining 26 split into 4 pure projections, 16 state reads, 1 clock, 3 authority-minting and 2 external-effect targets.

proposition: The structured frontend TARGET_VPS_PASS indicates ClayCode surface coverage of the Frank corpus.
refutation: Measured: 3 of 40 .clay sources parse under FRANK_STRUCTURED_V1 = 7.5 %. 13 distinct constructs separate that from full coverage, led by multi-line forms (8 sources), '=' defaults (8) and 'state' declarations (5).
status_mapping_note: QUALIFIED steht nicht im CLAIM_LIFECYCLE_PROTOCOL. Einzeln gelesen und auf REFUTED abgebildet: Falsifikator widerlegt die Aussage: 3 von 40 Quellen parsen (7,5 %), 13 Konstrukte fehlen zur Abdeckung. Urspruengliches Wort in first_status_original erhalten.

proposition: decide_effect requires host contracts before it can execute.
refutation: decide_effect reaches zero unresolved call targets — it calls only destructive_guard_complete, which calls nothing. It executes with no host bindings at all, in a purity-enforced context. The flagship policy was executable all along and only lacked an evaluator.

proposition: The live process's SQLite object is identified by its package version.
refutation: Package provenance is not object identity. The mapped object is now bound directly: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libsqlite3.so.0.8.6, build-id 92f59a77085057d1b9de43e943ba6231dc7ae452, sha256 f2cd05de8b6f71ea9d0495a6f9ff9cae844b15d9c45b7ef49ee0af0f81658cc7, read from /proc/self/maps rather than ldd. Linkage is SHARED_LIBSQLITE_MAPPED, not static.

proposition: SQLITE_SOURCE_ID can map the running binary to an upstream source tree.
refutation: The runtime source id is '2024-01-30 16:01:20 e876e51a...257ccalt1'. The suffix is not an upstream 3.45.1 digest, so source-id comparison cannot establish upstream lineage for this object. Any fix-presence argument leaning on source id must account for this.

proposition: The selected SQLite runtime may lose acknowledged commits under concurrent writers and unclean process termination.
refutation: 10 cycles x 6 concurrent writer processes, SIGKILL at a random instant, both synchronous=NORMAL and FULL: 12,807 acknowledged commits, 0 lost, 0 phantom, integrity_check ok after every kill, writable after every kill.

proposition: A SIGKILL crash oracle establishes power-loss durability.
refutation: SIGKILL terminates the process but does not discard the OS page cache. The oracle proves process-crash durability only. Power-loss and kernel-panic durability additionally depend on synchronous, filesystem barriers and the device honouring flushes, and require device-level fault injection.

proposition: No executable causal loop exists; the loop core is architecture prose only.
refutation: One full turn executes on real UnifiedDB state on the target VPS: observation -> memory -> pressure -> GWT selection -> broadcast -> receiver use -> proposal -> ClayCode effect authority -> reservation/attempt/verified outcome -> causal credit -> provenance-bound re-entry -> DONE -> admitted learning. 14 links recorded per turn, 7/7 checks.

proposition: Addressability and delivery of a workspace episode imply receiver use and causal credit.
refutation: The SHUFFLED arm preserves addressability and delivery but breaks content identity: receivers reconstruct a different candidate's content under the same episode identity. The chain is refused at receiver_use and no causal credit or learning follows. Operationally confirms addressable != delivered != reconstructed != used.

proposition: Provenance-bound re-entry needs a new mechanism to bind GWT identity to effect completion.
refutation: The existing V17 candidate schema already carries episode_id, signal_id and causal_id on a bound re-entry. The GWT episode identity binds INTO the effect completion record and is enforced by schema triggers, not by application state. No new mechanism was required.

proposition: Re-entry in this slice is a boolean flag rather than an information path.
refutation: Truthful control pressure moves 0.70 -> 0.80 between turns because the loop reads its own admitted learning delta. Smallest demonstration that the re-entry edge carries information. NOTE the honest limit: the learning model is a single delta hash, so pressure saturates at 0.80 thereafter.

proposition: The unresolved-call-target count for frank_effects.clay is a single well-defined number.
refutation: It depends on whether host contracts are declared. 29 = raw gap with no contract declared (matches supervisor count). 3 = residual after host.py declares 26 intrinsics. 0 = after the three undeclared types are declared. Declaring a contract converts unknown into declared-contract-with-effect-class; it does not implement it. Both prior numbers were correct and measured different states.
status_mapping_note: QUALIFIED steht nicht im CLAIM_LIFECYCLE_PROTOCOL. Einzeln gelesen und auf REFUTED abgebildet: Falsifikator widerlegt die Aussage: die Zahl ist nicht eindeutig, sie haengt von deklarierten host contracts ab (29 / 3). Urspruengliches Wort in first_status_original erhalten.

proposition: The Clay source enforces model_gwt_translator_claygraph_cannot_mint_authority by the same filtering step as the Python reference.
refutation: Stronger on the Clay side: EffectRequest never declares model_confidence, gwt_ignition, claygraph_salience or translator_effect_hint at all, so the record structurally cannot carry them. Python enforces it procedurally by excluding them from the hash; Clay enforces it structurally. Verified live - constructing with any of the four names raises unknown field(s).

proposition: verb_for is a host-binding detail that a contract declaration resolves.
refutation: No .clay source declares a Verb type or any kind-to-verb pairing. begin_effect_attempt and execute both require cap.verbs contains verb_for(intent.kind), so the capability check has no declared semantics to check against. This is a hole in the capability model (F-V01-12), not a binding detail. Bound as identity and explicitly marked unvalidated rather than guessed.

proposition: Truthful provenance-bound outcome re-entry causally improves downstream adaptive behavior; the causal carrier is binding validity, not data volume — misattributed and hash-broken receipts are behaviorally worth exactly zero.
refutation: 30 seeds, 4 arms, identical policy/environment/seeds, only outcome->state binding lesioned: TRUTHFUL 0.601 vs SHUFFLED/NO_REENTRY/SABOTAGED each 0.275 mean success; 29/30 wins, 1 tie, 0 inversions, sign-test p~2.9e-8; broken arms bitwise identical. Sandbox scope only; C-OPEN-001 (live) remains open.

scope: sandbox loop-core L2 lesion matrix, checks reproduced on target VPS
proposition: Misattributed outcome feedback is behaviorally worse than no feedback (-4.9pp, sign test p=0.016, 30/30 seeds), while provenance-hash-broken feedback is exactly equivalent to no feedback under any selection rule. Fail-closed provenance validation is therefore behaviorally load-bearing: it caps corrupted re-entry damage at zero information, never misinformation.
refutation: Lesion ordering TRUTHFUL 0.581 > NONE=SABOTAGED 0.296 (bitwise identical) > SHUFFLED 0.247. SABOTAGED=NONE because hash validation rejects every broken row regardless of policy. Sandbox scope; live FRANK and GWT untouched.

proposition: The FRANK_STRUCTURED_V1 surface covers 7.5 % of the ClayCode corpus and the remaining constructs are a long tail.
refutation: Coverage is now 36/40 = 90.0 %, reached in six evidence-driven increments, each gated on no LALR conflicts + identical baseline parse structure + differential gate PASS. Four sources remain deliberately rejected: two need a multi-statement lambda body that collides with set_literal at LALR level, two carry free-form prose notation whose formalization would require inventing unevidenced grammar.

proposition: A differential gate passing 200,576 requests with zero mismatches establishes that the evaluator implements the language correctly.
refutation: The evaluator silently ignored ! negation: ?unary_expr with an anonymous ! token filtered out leaves one child, so Lark inlines the rule and the Not node is never built. f(true) returned True. The gate did not catch it because claycode/frank_effects.clay never uses ! - it writes == false. A differential gate certifies the paths its corpus exercises, not the language.
